episodes.synopsis: Tsubasa and his team face off in a return match against the All Europe Soccer Team.

info.title: Il cuore di Cosette (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Liberamente tratto dal famoso romanzo "Les Misérables" dello scrittore francese Victor Hugo, "Il cuore di Cosette" offre uno spaccato storico e umano di ampio respiro che ben si colloca nel tradizionale e ambizioso progetto conosciuto come "World Masterpiece Theater" (serie animate ispirate ai capolavori della letteratura per ragazzi) della nota casa di produzione Nippon Animation.

"Essere una ragazza madre è difficile nella Francia di inizio XIX secolo. Lo sa bene la madre della piccola Cosette, che non riesce a trovare un lavoro e un posto dove vivere perchè pochi datori di lavoro sono disposti ad assumere una ragazza nelle sue condizioni. Quando le viene proposto un lavoro in una grande città decide di separarsi dalla figlia con la speranza di trovare qualcuno che se ne prenda cura mentre guadagna i soldi necessari. Purtroppo la famiglia che ha preso in affidamento la ragazza è tutt'altro che buona e per lei si prospetta un'infanzia per niente facile..."

episodes.title: Una separazione dolorosa
episodes.synopsis: Fantine è una ragazza madre che dopo essere stata abbandonata dal suo uomo e aver perduto il lavoro, vende tutti i suoi pochi averi e si lascia Parigi con Cosette, la figlia di quattro anni, alla ricerca di una nuova occupazione. Purtroppo per una donna con una figlia in tenera età è difficile trovare lavoro e Fantine è costretta a lasciare temporaneamente Cosette presso i Thénardier, due locandieri della cittadina di Montfermeil, per poi recarsi a Montreuil-sur-Mer, dove c'è una grande fabbrica che avrebbe potuto assumerla. Qui incontra per caso il signor Madeleine, sindaco della città e proprietario della fabbrica, proprio quando l'uomo per salvare Alain, un ragazzino che aveva rubato una pagnotta, intercede per lui con il fornaio.

episodes.title: Il segreto nascosto
episodes.synopsis: コゼットがワーテルロー亭で厳しくつらい日々を送っていることを知らぬまま、無事にマドレーヌの経営する工場に仕事を得たファンティーヌ…。

episodes.title: Un nuovo amico
episodes.synopsis: 市長室で赴任の挨拶を受けるマドレーヌは、マドレーヌの風貌にジャン・ヴァルジャンの面影を見るジャヴェール警部の言葉に、不安を隠せずにいた…。

episodes.title: Una lettera da Fantine
episodes.synopsis: ファンティーヌからの手紙が届いたのを見たコゼットは、字が読めるようになることを望む。こっそり覗き込んだ学校の書き取りの授業を思い出しながら単語をガヴローシュと一緒に口ずさんでいた時…。

episodes.title: Il bottone scomparso
episodes.synopsis: 自らの危険を顧みず、馬車の下敷きになったフォーシュルヴァンを救い出したマドレーヌ。物陰からそれを見ていたジャヴェールは、その怪力に、マドレーヌはジャン・ヴァルジャンではないかとの疑念を強めた…。

episodes.title: Il profumo dei ricordi
episodes.synopsis: 工場の中で子どものいることが噂になってしまい、女工仲間の嫌がらせに耐えるファンティーヌ。コゼットの誕生日に迎えに行けることを願って日々を過ごしていたが…。

episodes.title: Un regalo per Cosette
episodes.synopsis: ワーテルロー亭にパリ帰りのお客・ベランジェが立ち寄った。食卓を囲みながら、エポニーヌはベランジェの土産話に聞き入り、華やかな都・パリへの憧れを募らせていく…。

episodes.title: Arriva l'inverno
episodes.synopsis: 工場を首になってから仕事の見つからないファンティーヌ。そうと知らずテナルディエは理由をつけてはコゼットの養育費をねだる…。

episodes.title: L'illusione di Fantine
episodes.synopsis: 通りすがりに受けた嫌がらせに歯向かったファンティーヌは、反対に自分が悪者として逮捕されそうになるが、そこへマドレーヌが登場して彼女を救う…。

episodes.title: Una scelta difficile
episodes.synopsis: いよいよ自らコゼット迎えに行こうとした矢先に、ジャヴェールから「ジャン・ヴァルジャンが捕まった」と聞かされて以来、悩み続けているマドレーヌ…。

episodes.title: La prima menzogna
episodes.synopsis: マドレーヌの帰りをひたすら待ち続けるアランとシスター･サンプリス。日に日に弱るファンティーヌを慰めることしかできない二人の前にマドレーヌが現れ…。

episodes.title: Cosette resta sola
episodes.synopsis: 警察の網をかいくぐりモンフェルメイユ村へと急ぐジャン･ヴァルジャンは、間一髪のところでジャヴェールの追っ手をかわす…。

episodes.title: Cosette e il nuovo amico
episodes.synopsis: 夜の森で出会ったコゼットの水汲みを助けたジャン･ヴァルジャンは、通りすがりの旅人の振りをしてワーテルロー亭に宿泊を求める…。

episodes.title: Cosette conosce la verità
episodes.synopsis: ワーテルロー亭から無事コゼットを連れ出したジャン･ヴァルジャンは、追っ手を避けながら街道沿いをパリへと向かっていた…。

episodes.title: La forza dell'affetto
episodes.synopsis: パリへ向かう途中、運河と大聖堂のある大きな街に立ち寄るジャン･ヴァルジャンとコゼット。賑やかな街並みに目を見張るコゼットは…。

episodes.title: Finalmente a Parigi
episodes.synopsis: パリの街外れにあるゴルボー屋敷で、名を偽ったジャン･ヴァルジャンとコゼットの新しい生活が始まった。ジャンはコゼットとの穏やかで心慰められる生活を大切に思うが…。

episodes.title: La scoperta
episodes.synopsis: パリに暖かく柔らかな春が訪れるが、ジャン･ヴァルジャンとコゼットは、変わらず人目を避けゴルボー屋敷でひっそり暮らしていた…。

episodes.title: Un incontro inaspettato
episodes.synopsis: ジャヴェールによって路地に追い込まれたジャン･ヴァルジャンとコゼット。高い塀を乗り越えて間一髪で逃げ込んだ先は修道院の庭だった…。

episodes.title: Un'impresa rischiosa
episodes.synopsis: ジャンが決意した危険な賭けとは、亡くなったシスターのために用意された棺おけに隠れて修道院を逃れることだった。コゼットとジャンが修道院に隠れていると疑わず…。

episodes.title: Cosette e il flauto
episodes.synopsis: 危険を乗り越え無事に戻ってきたジャンとコゼットは、修道院での新しい生活が始まった。ジャンはフォーシュルヴァンの弟と名乗り庭師として働き、コゼットは修道院の女学校に通い始める…。

episodes.title: La storia di Marius
episodes.synopsis: ベアトリスが修道院の学院を離れ、家族の元に戻ることになった。皆でお別れをしながら、コゼットも将来の自分に想いを馳せる。ジルノルマン家にはマリウスの父の危篤の報が届くが…。

episodes.title: Una nuova vita per Cosette
episodes.synopsis: 夜逃げしたテナルディエの代わりに借金取りに追われ、コゼットを思いながらひっそりとパリへ向かって出発するガヴローシュ…。

episodes.title: Sotto il cielo di Parigi
episodes.synopsis: 修道院に別れを告げたコゼットとジャン。これから暮らすパリの街の賑やかな様子に驚くが、パリは不景気ですさんだ人々の集まる街でもあった…。

episodes.title: Prime passioni
episodes.synopsis: シュシュと一緒にパリへ着いたガヴローシュは、浮浪児たちと一緒にたくましく生活していた。ゴルボー屋敷では、エポニーヌがマリウスを知るに連れ一層惹かれていく…。

episodes.title: Incertezze d'amore
episodes.synopsis: リュクサンブール公園で、互いの名前も知らぬままひそやかに視線を交わし始めるコゼットとマリウス。マリウスを意識して元気をなくすコゼットをジャンは案じるが…。

episodes.title: Destini incrociati
episodes.synopsis: ブリュメ通りの古い屋敷に新しく居を構えたジャンとコゼット。密かに警察を恐れるジャンによって、リュクサンブール公園へと出かけられなくなったコゼットは…。

episodes.title: Una bambina in fuga
episodes.synopsis: 礼拝を終えた教会の中で、ジャンの戻りを待っていたコゼットは、青ざめ苦しげな様子の女性を助けた。屋敷に連れ帰ると、その女性はロザリーヌと名乗り…。

episodes.title: Le lettere smarrite
episodes.synopsis: ゴルボー屋敷の近くの雪道で、マリウスが拾った4通の手紙。それは、テナルディエの書いたお金を無心する偽の手紙だった。手紙を失くしてしまったエポニーヌは…。

episodes.title: Pericolo in agguato
episodes.synopsis: やって来た「慈善家の紳士」がジャン・ヴァルジャンだと気づいたテナルディエは、仲間を集め長年の恨みを果たそうと企みを巡らし始めた…。

episodes.title: In fuga
episodes.synopsis: 悪党たちに囲まれたジャンの前で、とうとう正体を現したテナルディエ。警察に合図するために隣の部屋に隠れていたマリウスは…。

episodes.title: Giorni sereni
episodes.synopsis: テナルディエのたくらみから辛くもコゼットの元に戻ることができたジャン・ヴァルジャンは、腕に負った傷のせいで体を弱らせてしまった…。

episodes.title: La lunga ombra del passato
episodes.synopsis: 仲間たちとフォルス監獄に囚われたままのテナルディエは、ジャン・ヴァルジャンへの復讐を誓い、脱獄の機会をじっとうかがっていた…。

episodes.title: L'ombra misteriosa
episodes.synopsis: ようやく元気になり、コゼットに見送られて旅支度で馬車に乗り込むジャン。御者に告げた行き先は、幼いコゼットが育ったモンフェルメイユ村だった…。

episodes.title: Un elefante come rifugio
episodes.synopsis:
視聴する

とうとう再会できたマリウスとコゼット。夜の庭でひそやかに言葉を交わすうち、コゼットは幼い頃の身の上を打ち明け、自分を助けてくれたガヴローシュのことをマリウスに伝える…。

episodes.title: L'evasione
episodes.synopsis: 激しい雷鳴と雨が降る夜、とうとうパトロンミネットたちがフォルス監獄から脱獄した。警備兵に追いかけられて屋根から足を滑らせてしまったテナルディエを助けたのは…。

episodes.title: Parigi soffre
episodes.synopsis: 流行り病が収まらず、パリの街は一層不安な空気に包まれていた。ジャンは学校の建設をあきらめ、貧しい人々のための病院を作ろうと奔走していた…。

episodes.title: Un incontro amaro
episodes.synopsis: 市民の期待を背負ったラマルク将軍が姿を見せなくなり、パリの街にはますます重い空気が広がっていた。革命の噂がささやかれ…。

episodes.title: Vecchi rancori
episodes.synopsis: マリウスを信じて待っていたコゼットに、今すぐ荷物をまとめ屋敷を出ることを突然告げるジャン。コゼットは再びマリウスと会えなくなることを恐れるが…。

episodes.title: Vento di rivoluzione
episodes.synopsis: マリウスがようやくコゼットを訪ねたとき、既に一家は屋敷を立ち去った後だった。マリウスは悲嘆に暮れながら、夜のパリの街でコゼットを探し続けた…。

episodes.title: La notte della rivoluzione
episodes.synopsis: 今やパリのあちこちにバリケードが築かれ、市民と警官たちが睨み合いを続けていた。アンジョルラスたちのいるコラント酒場のバリケードでは…。

episodes.title: Un grande amore
episodes.synopsis: マリウスの必死の働きによって危機を脱することができたコラント。静まり返る周囲の様子に、バリケードの仲間たちは次の攻撃に忙しく備えていた…。

episodes.title: Jean Valjean e Javert
episodes.synopsis: バリケードの中に潜り込みアンジョルラスたちを偵察していたジャヴェールは、ガヴローシュに正体を気づかれ、とうとう捕らえられてしまう…。

episodes.title: Il piccolo eroe
episodes.synopsis: コラントの店の中で、ジャンは、捕らえられ柱に縛られたジャヴェールと再会する。一方、家に戻らないジャンを心配するコゼットも、こっそりと屋敷を抜け出て教会へと向かうのだった…。

episodes.title: La fiamma della speranza
episodes.synopsis: ロマルメ通りのアパートでは、医者に手当てを受けたガブローシュが眠っていた。コゼットは、自分との約束を守り、ガヴローシュを助けてくれたシュシュを抱きしめるのだった…。

episodes.title: Le fogne di Parigi
episodes.synopsis: ついにすべてのバリケードが陥落し、学生たちの革命も失われてしまった。瓦礫の中でジャヴェールは必死にジャンを探すが見つからない…。

episodes.title: I rimorsi di Javert
episodes.synopsis: 地下水道から抜け出しセーヌ河のほとりに辿り着いたジャンを待っていたのは、ジャヴェールだった。自らの信念に基づき、ジャンを捕らえようとするジャヴェールだったが…。

episodes.title: L'ultimo addio
episodes.synopsis: 置いてきたブレソールとユーグを案じて、怪我が治らないまま出て行こうとするガヴローシュ。コゼットが心配して引きとめていると、ジャンが2人を連れてアパートに戻ってくる…。

episodes.title: Finalmente la felicità
episodes.synopsis: 秋になって大分体が回復してきたマリウス。ジルノルマン邸の庭で、コゼットと2人で穏やかな時間を過ごしていた。歩けるようになったマリウスは…。

episodes.title: Mia madre
episodes.synopsis: 母・ファンティーヌに結婚の報告をするために、モントルイユ・シュル・メールへと向かうことになったコゼット。母の眠る町にガヴローシュとともに旅立ったコゼットは…。

episodes.title: Un'eterna promessa d'amore
episodes.synopsis: 念願だった新しい学校の建設も進む頃、コゼットの結婚式が迫ってきていた。弁護士の試験にも合格し、幸せなマリウスとコゼットを前にしながら…。

episodes.title: La verità svelata
episodes.synopsis: 自らの秘密をとうとうマリウスに告げたジャンは、すべてを託して2人の前から消え去ってしまう。しかし、ジャンのこれまでの行いを思い起こせば起こすほど…。

episodes.title: Il senso di una vita
episodes.synopsis: パリの街にノートルダム寺院の鐘が鳴り響く。ジャンの作り上げた学校では、ガヴローシュや子どもたちが教室で一生懸命学んでいる。弁護士事務所を開いたマリウスは…。

info.title: Nausicaä della Valle del Vento
info.synopsis: La terra, devastata da un olocausto nucleare, è un deserto arido e inospitale dominato da una giungla tossica esalante venefici miasmi in continua espansione. La civiltà degli uomini, regredita a uno stadio medievale, occupa sparute oasi di natura fertile, fra cui la Valle del vento, un piccolo e pacifico regno guidato dalla giovane principessa Nausicaä. Questa, convinta protettrice di ogni forma di vita e caparbia ricercatrice, è molto vicina a trovare una soluzione per "guarire" la foresta fungina e di conseguenza l'intero ecosistema. Ma il suo regno rimarrà intrappolato nello scacchiere di due grandi potenze belligeranti sconsideratamente pronte a scatenare un'altra catastrofe, e Nausicaä dovrà fare appello a tutto il suo coraggio e alla sua forza d'animo quando il destino del suo popolo si compirà con l'avverarsi di un'antica profezia.

info.title: Guilty Gear Strive: Dual Rulers
info.synopsis: Dopo il declino di scienza e tecnologia, una nuova fonte energetica nota come "magia" alimenta l'epoca moderna. L'umanità arriva così a creare delle armi biologiche proibite, i Gears, che a un certo punto si ribellano. Il genere umano sopravvive al conflitto, ma con perdite enormi, con ferite anche emotive che nemmeno con i decenni trascorsi si sono completamente rimarginate. In questo contesto, Sin Kiske, figlio di un umano e di un Gear, si reca al matrimonio dei suoi genitori, considerabile per certi versi come un'eresia, e infatti persino in un mondo oramai in pace sono serviti molti anni per poter celebrare le nozze. All'improvviso, appare una misteriosa ragazza, che detesta i Gears... l'incontro tra il figlio di una simile unione e la ragazza sconvolgerà il mondo.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Sin witnesses his parents’ sacrifice and vows to confront Unika to learn her true motive.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Unika disrupts the peace ceremony, triggering a fierce clash as Sin tries to reach her true intentions.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Sin confronts Unika to prevent a new war, while Elphelt goes missing during a critical investigation.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Sin confronts his failures, Unika questions herself, and the true enemy's identity begins to surface.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Sin and Unika lose control as Future Nerville’s plan triggers a global Gear rampage.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: With the world at stake, the warriors clash against a relentless power that threatens everything.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Sin leads a final charge to stop Nerville as allies unite and the fate of the world hangs in the balance.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Unika and Sin face a pivotal battle that will shape their futures.

info.title: Gatchaman Fighter (ITA)
info.synopsis:
Dopo la presunta distruzione definitiva del Leader X alla fine di "Gatchaman II", un suo frammento sopravvissuto si rigenera mutando in un'entità chiamata Z. Alleatosi con il Conte Egobossler, capo della famiglia Egobossler (affiancato dai suoi sottoposti Mechandol e Kempler), Z intende portare a compimento la distruzione della Terra e annientare una volta per tutte la Squadra Ninja Scientifica.

Nel frattempo, a seguito della morte di Anderson, il Dr. Nambu assume la guida dell'ISO. La squadra, ora di base a Gallatown (soprannominata "G-Town"), una struttura sottomarina, viene affiancata dall'ingegnere Kamo. Quando il nuovo GodPhoenix viene distrutto nelle prime fasi dello scontro, il team riceve il Gatchaspartan, un mecha avanzato dotato di una modalità speciale – l'Hypershoot – accessibile solo a Ken grazie alla sua nuova spada, il Gatchafencer.

Con il procedere della serie, però, si scopre che l'Hypershoot emette radiazioni letali: l'uso prolungato sta lentamente uccidendo Ken, e continuare significherebbe condannarlo a morte. Nel frattempo, Z mette in atto il suo piano definitivo: colpire la Terra con un asteroide di antimateria, ribattezzato "Poison Apple".

episodes.title: La vendetta del Generalissimo X
episodes.synopsis: Weeks after the dust settles from Sosai X's destruction, a tiny fragment of the alien revives and begins to rebuild itself into Sosai Zed. Using the remains of an old shipyard, Zed builds a vast mechanical pyramid fortress and levitates it over the ocean. Meanwhile, the rest of the world quits rebuilding from the wreckage of the thwarted Solar Shift Plan and go back to what they do best: waging war. We meet Count Egobossler, successful ruler of a growing number of territories, and an aspiring megalomaniac. Egobossler meets Sosai Zed, who decides to use Egobossler's brilliant military tactics to his own advantage, and the two strike a deal. In the wake of Chief Anderson's death in Gatchaman II, Nambu is promoted to Chief Administrator of the ISO. The Kagaku Ninjatai cope with the unusual peace. Feeling useless during peacetime, Joe wallows in boredom and self pity while Nambu tries to find a way to recharge him after his near-destruction in G-II.

episodes.title: Gatch Spartan
episodes.synopsis: Egobossler's first attack, backed up by one of Zed's giant mechs, completely startles out heroes. Ken, Jun, Jinpei and Ryu rush to the scene of the battle (leaving Joe behind to quietly expire). The mech is too powerful, and the New Godphoenix is completely trashed in the first skirmish with Egobossler. Fortunately, Chief Engineer Saburo Kamo is waiting in the wings with brand new mechs. With only one problem: the new vehicles need five operators to combine. It's up to Joe, who upon hearing the phrase, "Gallactor has returned," will crawl on his final strength to rejoin the team. TheGatchaspartan saves the day.

episodes.title: Libertà riconquistata
episodes.synopsis: 驚異的なスピードで勢力を拡大するギャラクターは、アグリカ大陸侵攻作戦の拠点として、荒れ地の村のオアシスを占拠した。忍者隊は村長の助けを受けながら、何とか村に潜入し奪還に成功。次に忍者隊はオアシス爆破を計画していたが、村人の生活用水でもあるため、奪回へと変更する。

episodes.title: L'isola di Parlon
episodes.synopsis: 前線基地にするために、独立国パーロン島を占領したギャラクター。忍者隊は島の奪還に向かうが、国民を人質に取られ島に近づく事が出来ずにいた。敵に見つからないよう、一人で島に潜入した健だったが、ギャラクターの特殊部隊アイアンコマンドに発見され、崖から海へ突き落とされてしまう。

episodes.title: Il guerriero audace
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターの攻撃は熾烈を極め、戦火は世界各地に広がっていった。そんな中、忍者隊は救援物資を乗せた国際赤十字の貨物船を、難民の集まる港町カナルまで護衛する。しかし、突如鉄獣メカが海中から現れ、救助船を破壊。そして難民達は軍需工場の奴隷として、ギャラクターに捕らえられてしまった

episodes.title: La fortezza del Conte Egobozler
episodes.synopsis: Ken asks the same question viewers have probably been asking since the beginning: "Enough battling the little guys--why can't we meet Egobossler head on?" The Team does, but fails miserably. This episode ends in a very disturbing role reversal scene with Ken--now beyond reason--raging at a laughing Egobossler, and Joe finally having to bring all his strength into play to drag Ken back into the Gatchaspartan.

episodes.title: Il doppio gioco
episodes.synopsis: The Kagaku Ninjatai continue their tries at direct confrontation by stealing aboard Zed's tower and facing him directly. This doesn't work either (can we say "outnumbered"?), though they do get in a few good punches.

episodes.title: Il grande Sam
episodes.synopsis: ゲルトランドの刑務所から、大量の囚人達が脱走した。ギャラクターはその地に建設されているデーターバンク要塞に近づく囚人達を、容赦なく殺害していく。一方、ギャラクターの作戦データを入手するために要塞へと向かった健とジョーは、その途中で逃亡中の三人の囚人達と出会う。

episodes.title: Il vero Amore
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターに荷担し、地球上のどんな物質でも破壊するという物質消滅砲の開発を進めるドール博士。その娘のカレンが、基地を脱走し国防軍キャンプに保護された。父親の行いをやめさせるために説得したというカレンを連れて、忍者隊はヘルプス山脈のギャラクター基地へと向かう。

episodes.title: Emergenza alla base Gatchaman
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターは奪われたアグリカ侵攻作戦のデーターを奪い返そうと、ガッチャマン基地の場所を探る。だが、ISOの厳密な警備に情報収集はままならず、エゴボスラーは捕らえていた犯罪者ヴィッテンドルフを送り込む。

episodes.title: Tiger Express
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターのアグリカ侵攻作戦の重要機材を乗せた列車・Zプレスが、バブラルタル鉄橋へ向かっていた。上空から列車を破壊しようとする忍者隊であったが、車中に人質の姿を見つけ攻撃出来ない。

episodes.title: Una missione pericolosa
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターの大部隊が、ついにアグリカ侵攻作戦を開始した。だが、忍者隊も奪い取った作戦データの解読にようやく成功。ギャラクターの目的がマントルエネルギーや鉄鉱石などの、資源基地の占拠であることが判明した。

episodes.title: La resa dei conti
episodes.synopsis: アグリカに展開するギャラクター部隊と、国連軍との決戦の火蓋が切って落とされた。忍者隊は偽のガッチャスパルタンを敵に撃墜させ、油断している隙にエゴボスラーの潜む司令基地を叩くという作戦を開始。ジョーと竜はギャラクター戦闘員に、残り三人は旅人に変装して別方向からの侵入を試みる。

episodes.title: Il palazzo di Egobozler
episodes.synopsis: 忍者隊の作戦によって、ギャラクターはアグリカから撤退した。エゴボスラーは本部であるサタンフォーヘンに帰還し、世界各地でも部隊の敗走が始まった。この機を逃さずにギャラクターを潰そうと、単独でサタンフォーヘンの街へ侵入した健は、街で普通の生活を送るギャラクター兵士達の姿に驚く。

episodes.title: L'ambizione di Egobozler
episodes.synopsis: 忍者隊と国連軍にサタンフォーヘンを破壊されたギャラクターは、世界中から姿を消して廃墟の地下に潜んでいた。総裁Zはエゴボスラーの失態を責め、その関係を対等な協力者から主従関係へと改めさせる。野望達成のため渋々承伏するエゴボスラー。

episodes.title: Farfalla della notte
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターの敗走により、世界は訪れた平和に沸いていた。しかし新天地、地底都市ギャラタウンへの移住を完了したギャラクターは、再び活動を開始。その手始めとして、アイゼン大統領とその娘アベリアを脅迫。彼らが平和外交のために各国首脳に贈るチューリップに仕掛けをし、首脳達の殺害を企てた。

episodes.title: Città diabolica
episodes.synopsis: 特殊な鉱石から抽出した神経ガスをタンクローリーに詰め、ニュージョークの街に上陸したギャラクター。中心街でガスがばらまかれ、多数の被害者がでてしまった。自分のミスでギャラクターの侵入を許してしまった甚平は、ガスに苦しむ少女に自分の酸素ボンベを与え倒れてしまう。

episodes.title: Glorioso scontro
episodes.synopsis: 各国に点在する国連軍の秘密武器庫が、ギャラクターによって相次いで奇襲を受けた。敵は圧倒的な攻撃力により、基地を完虚無きまでに破壊。中でも特殊戦闘機隊のリーダーは"チチリアの鷹"と呼ばれ、国連軍の兵士達に恐れられていた。

episodes.title: L'ultrasostanza
episodes.synopsis: Mercenary scientist Professor Gordon develops an indestructible material called Neophryte and decides to sell it to the highest bidder. So he summons agents from both Gallactor (Egobossler's first officer, Kempler) and the ISO (the Gatchaman, naturally) to meet alone on a spot he specifies. Of course Kempler doesn't come alone, but much to both his and Ken's surprise, neither does Ken. While the Gallactors and the rest of the Kagaku Ninjatai take part in a snarling standoff outside, Gordon, Kempler and Ken negotiate. Kempler offers money, while Ken refuses to haggle, stating honor and decency as his reasons (and knowing as Gordon does that once he withdraws his protection, Gallactor will simply take what they want by force). Worried about his father, Gordon's son finally ends the standoff and uncovers the compound for both sides to fight over. Joe uses a bazooka loaded with Neophryte to blow a hole in the monstermech that appears at the end.

episodes.title: Triplo mostro di acciaio
episodes.synopsis: 総裁Zの正体を研究しているスペンサー博士の依頼により、ボギー島の宇宙科学研究所へ総裁Xに関するデータを運ぶ忍者隊。だが自分の正体を探る者の存在を感じ取った総裁Zは、島の破壊をエゴボスラーに命令。

episodes.title: Gli uccelli di fuoco
episodes.synopsis: 両親の墓参りのため、生まれ育ったBC島へと戻ったジョー。そこはかってギャラクターの重要拠点であり、忍者隊の活躍によって平和を取り戻した地でもあった。両親の墓前で偶然、幼馴染みのアンナと再会し、昔話に花を咲かせる二人。

episodes.title: Attentato al satellite
episodes.synopsis: かつて総裁Xの部下として、ソーラーシフト計画の一角を担ったマーストラは生きていた。火星基地から人知れず地球宙域へ戻ったマーストラは、資源調査衛星レムリア７号を占処。一方、南海の無人島にギャラクターの部隊が上陸したという情報を得て、忍者隊は島に潜入。

episodes.title: Ipnotizzazione collettiva
episodes.synopsis: 平和運動家のタンガニア国王は、パレードの途中に子供達に襲われる。健の機転により事なきを得るが、何故か同じような事件が各所で続発していた。しかも彼らは、事件を何も覚えていない。

episodes.title: Il guerriero orgoglioso
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターの輸送機を追い、アグリカ上空を飛ぶガッチャスパルタン。だが敵の攻撃を受け、健のガッチャ１号が堕落してしまった。仲間を探そうとしてジャングルをさまよう健は、シンバという現地の青年と出会い、彼の村で一夜を過ごすことに。

episodes.title: Sky Rider all'Inferno
episodes.synopsis: One of Egobossler's old friends and colleagues Oncain, is also the last man on Earth who knows Count Egobossler's deep, dark secrets. The Kagaku Ninjatai get to Oncain first and try to convince him to stay away from Egobossler, but the man will have nothing of it. He invites the Team to go fox-hunting and with his two children, Michael and Mary, and as they're distracted, arranges to meet with Egobossler. The inevitable showdown with Egobossler and his special Skyrider command is spectacular, but even Ken and Joe at their best can't prevent Ego from gunning down his man. Joe comes round the corner just in time as Ego shoots Oncain right before Michael and Mary's eyes (triggering a flashback where you almost see the faces of Joe's parents). In the final scene, Joe kneels down and has a little heart-to-heart talk with Michael. You don't hear what he says, only Michael's reactions.

episodes.title: L'abilità di G-1
episodes.synopsis: ISOによる宇宙パルス研究を、なぜか異常なまでに恐れる総裁Z。エゴボスラーはカウベラ市の宇宙パルス研究所を破壊するよう命じられるが、街は国連軍が守っておりうかつに手を出す事が出来ない。

episodes.title: Il segreto di Egobozler
episodes.synopsis: サタンフォーヘンから亡命したゼルダという女性が、ギャラクターの追撃を逃れてISOに保護された。彼女は｢悪魔の子エルン。アイン川上流の城。エゴボスラー｣という謎の言葉を残し意識を失う。

episodes.title: Battaglia disperata
episodes.synopsis: コンゴール国のレジスタンスから、忍者隊の元へ密告書が届いた。そこには大統領のザバンダとギャラクターの、ウラン鉱石を巡る癒着が示されていた。

episodes.title: Fratello e sorella
episodes.synopsis: セラリア市のマントルエネルギー工場を強襲したギャラクターであったが、国連軍のフェイザー戦車部隊の攻撃により撤退。マーストラはエゴボスラーから反撃作戦の指揮軍を剥奪し、部下のシャラムを工場へと向かわせた。

episodes.title: L'alieno
episodes.synopsis: マーストラは前回の失敗の汚名を返上しようと、新たな作戦を開始。火星から持ち帰った粘液状生物をニュージョーク市に放し、街の人々を襲わせ始めた。

episodes.title: La grande corsa
episodes.synopsis: 総裁Ｚの秘密の鍵、宇宙パルスＡＱ３の研究チームリーダー、スタール博士がギャラクターに誘拐された。更に宇宙エネルギーの研究者達が次々と誘拐され、地底列車でギャラクタウンへと送られようとしていた。

episodes.title: La pulsazione spaziale
episodes.synopsis: 総裁Zの命令により、各地の天文台を次々と破壊するギャラクター。その対策会議中の南部の元へ、鴨枝師長の孫の正一が祖父に会いたいとやってきた。だが、鴨枝は宇宙パルスを分析するパルス集束機を開発中で、会うことは出来ない。

episodes.title: Ryu l'eroe
episodes.synopsis: 海洋学者ベアリー博士を乗せた観測船が、北極海で海中から突き出た巨大な角に襲われ消息を絶った。船が出港したナルベカ港の調査を開始した竜は、そこで謎の男達に追われるルシーという少女を助ける。

episodes.title: Il trucco di Egobozler
episodes.synopsis: 南部長官の元へ、宇宙物理学者のシュバール氏から接触を求める連絡が入った。シュバールの宇宙パルス研究がＩＳＯよりも進んでいることを知った南部は、忍者隊にも知らせずに、変装して単独シュバールの元へ向かう。

episodes.title: La morte sfiora Ken
episodes.synopsis: シュバールの研究レポートを元に、宇宙パルスの解明を進める南部。一方、エゴボスラーもパルスの謎に迫るが、その企てに気づいた総裁Ｚは、自ら計画の内容を明かす。それは宇宙の彼方で製作中の反物質小惑星を、地球にぶつけるというものであった。

episodes.title: L'indomabile G-1
episodes.synopsis: 宇宙パルスの解明を急ぐため、特殊潜水艇で北極の秘密宇宙観測所へ向かう南部と忍者隊。だが、健だけはＧスーツとの同調訓練という名目で、一人基地に残っていた。その航海途上、健の不調の原因に気づいていたジョーは、南部に事情の説明を求める。

episodes.title: Ancora avanti Gatchaman
episodes.synopsis: 度重なるハイパーシュートの使用より、細胞破壊の進行が早まる健の肉体。細胞再生の可能性を探るため、南部とジュンは人体工学研究所へと向かう。研究中の細胞活性装置に健の細胞サンプルを掛けたところ、再生可能と判明。

episodes.title: Un legame d'amicizia
episodes.synopsis: イベリア地方に総裁Ｚの出現が確認され、探索に向かう忍者隊。手分けをして基地を探す中、甚兵は怪我をした犬ザクと、その飼い主の少女カミーラに出会う。彼女は遊牧民の娘で、集落がギャラクターに襲われ父親と仲間達が何処かへ連れさられてしまったという。

episodes.title: La caduta del Conte Egobozler
episodes.synopsis: ギャラクターの攻撃により、破壊された北極の観測所。しかし宇宙パルスの謎を解明するためには、北極圏で観測を続けるしかない。そこで南部の号令により、仮設観測所が建設されることとなった。

episodes.title: I fiori del ricordo
episodes.synopsis: 総攻撃を掛けるべく、ケンペラー率いる機動艦隊がニュージョークへ迫っていた。忍者隊は市民の避難誘導を開始、甚平は担当のセントマグダラ島に到着。そこで避難を拒否する子供達に出会うが、なんとか避難船へ乗り込ませた。

episodes.title: La distruzione della base Gatchaman
episodes.synopsis: 検査のため訪れた健は、廊下で看護婦にぶつかる。だが看護婦はエゴボスラーのスパイで、健に発信物資を付着させていた。健がガッチャマン基地へ戻ったことにより、エゴボスラーはその場所を知ってしまった。

episodes.title: Addio Dr. Nambu
episodes.synopsis: 宇宙パルスＡＱ３の真相に迫るため、自らの敵の手に落ちた南部。エゴボスラーは忍者隊の弱点を聞き出そうと、自白剤を投与。南部は強靭な精神力でたえながらも、過酷な責めにも苦しむ。

episodes.title: Gallactown distrutta
episodes.synopsis: ついに南部は凶弾に倒れた。粛々たる葬儀が行われる中、エオボスラーは立体映像によって改めて全世界に宣戦を布告し、基地を爆破した。その非道な行いに悲しみを堪え、打倒ギャラクターの決意を新たにする忍者隊。

episodes.title: L'incubo spaziale
episodes.synopsis: 超破壊力を秘めた反物質小惑星が、地球に迫りつつあった。これを阻止するための流星破壊用ミサイルが、忍者隊が厳重に整備する中、宇宙センターから打ち上げられた。だが時を同じくして、ギャラクターの鉄獣がニュージョークの市内を襲撃。

episodes.title: Minaccia spaziale
episodes.synopsis: 反物質小惑星は地球到達直前に、健と忍者隊の決死のウルトラハイパーシュートによって破壊された。だがその破片は地球に降り注ぎ、磁気嵐によって異常現象を引き起こしはじめた。天変地異が各国を襲い、都市は壊滅し世界が崩壊していく。

episodes.title: Ken disperato
episodes.synopsis: 健の細胞崩壊は限界まで進み、もう一度ハイパーシュートを使えば絶命するという段階にまで達していた。そして命を削ってまで破壊した反物質小惑星よりも更に巨大な惑星が、総裁Ｚによって地球に近づいている事が判明。

episodes.title: La Fine
episodes.synopsis: 反物質惑星の地球衝突を防ぐため、宇宙へ飛び立つガッチャパルタン。巨大な惑星の破壊は不可能と判断し、牽引する宇宙トラクターを破壊して、地球への軌道を逸らそうとする。だが護衛艦の攻撃に苦戦しつつもトラクターを破壊するが、惑星は軌道を変えず地球へと向かい続ける。

episodes.title: Gatchaman per sempre
episodes.synopsis: The Team searches for Zed in his tower, and are thrown around like playthings. When they finally meet up, they discover what happened to Egobossler: his corpse is pinned against a wall in Zed's main chamber, run through by his own sword. At this point, Joe picks up on Zed's vital signs (as Rafael had designed him to) and tracks the alien to his last refuge, where the Kagaku Ninjatai battle to destroy him... and fall. Chief Nambu's mysterious pendant (an unanalyzed device he'd instructed Kamo to give to the Team before the last battle) comes into play then, activating the Gatchaspartan and swallowing the fallen ninjas with light... The final scene is of an enormous firebird breaking free of Zed's exploding tower and flying around the Earth, leaving us to analyze the wide open ending. (Chances are high, though, that they aren't dead--they're still under contract, after all.

info.title: Renkin San-kyuu Magical? Pokaan
info.synopsis: La serie narra le bizzarre avventure di quattro ragazze molto particolari: Yūma la strega, Pachira il vampiro, Liru il licantropo e Aiko l'androide. Principesse di un altro mondo, decidono di avventurarsi in quello degli umani finendo per abitare in una casetta abbarbicata su un grande albero. La loro vita sarà un constante susseguirsi di situazioni comuni e non, una più divertente dell'altra.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis:
A. Super Doctor K-Ko and Hongo have devised traps that end up trapping Pachira, Liru, and Aiko. Thus, Uma ends up coming to the rescue.

B. Upon learning about mail, Uma tries to build a mailbox with Aiko's help so that the girls can receive mail. Then the next part involves trying to get the mailman on their route to give them mail.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis:
A. Following an incident at the prehistoric mammal section of the museum, Liru discovers love when she meets a man named Ryo who turns out to be another werewolf.

B. While watching TV, Uma and Pachira learn about home shopping when they see an Electric Trainer (a type of fitness belt) on TV. When Uma orders for the Electric Trainer, the other girls get interested in TV shopping until they learn that home shopping includes having to pay for the stuff.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis:
A. When encountering a cute guy outside of a Blood Donation Bus, Pachira ends up donating some of her blood and ends up weak. This ends up tempting her to try to suck blood from Uma and Liru.

B. While in a movie theater, the girls discuss their dream boyfriend. When Aiko's weight ends up disabling an elevator, the girls talk about how they would meet their dream boyfriend while stripping into their underclothes when the elevator gets warmer.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis:
A. During the rainy season, Aiko's systems are covered in mildew making her voice sound bad. While Liru is playing in the rain, Uma and Pachira try to clean Aiko's systems upon deactivating her.

B. A heat wave has struck Hikarigaoka and the girls learn that Tanabata occurs on the 7th of July while deciding what wish should be granted by it.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis:
A. When a typhoon ruins their day at the beach, the girls try to improvise at the nearest hotel.

B. Following an accident with their floats, the girls are saved from drowning by Lulu, a mermaid who is the princess of the merfolk. They soon help her in obtaining a boy that she has a crush on, who Yuma ends up take. Lulu finds a mate in a jellyfish and, at the end of the episode, Yuma and the other nether princess have a fight. The girls (excluding Yuma)go home, while Yuma and the boy go for a swim, the boy turns out to be a spirit leading Yuma to her doom.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis:
A. In a follow-up to the ending of the previous episode, Uma has died and is condemned to Hell by Enma (played by Super Doctor K-Ko). In each level of Hell, Uma encounters hellish and demonic counterparts of her fellow princesses where she ends up driving them crazy.

B. With help from Jun, Tan, and Liru's werewolf form, Uma performs magic tricks in the park to entertain the people there and show off her magic.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis:
A. Liru prepares for the viewing of the Full Moon by obtaining the supplies to it and finding a perfect spot in the park to view the Full Moon at.

B. In this Super Robot-type segment, Uma, Pachira, Liru, and Keimie act out as Magical 5 to save their teammate Aiko and their fuel company from a giant Mecha-Hongo robot created by Super Doctor K-Ko.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis:
A. People throughout Hikarigaoka are being attacked by a vampire at night. Jun, Tan, and Liru each suspect Pachira for the attacks upon seeing her silhouette attack someone. Pachira suspects that someone else is behind these attacks.

B. Aiko wins Happy Chalk from a prize in Makai Teen Magazine which can bring anything that's drawn to life. Since it can only work for a witch, Uma uses it to draw various things including drawing up a galactic train to take them to the Andromeda Galaxy in one of Aiko's attempts to gain a human body.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis:
A. While out getting Ishiyakiimo (yams baked on hot stones), Liru ends up saving a guy from being beaten up. She then ends up seeing a fallen CD with its shape turning her into her werewolf form. When Aiko invites him to their house, Liru doesn't want to be seen in her current form and Pachira wants him to herself.

B. After reading a Christmas story, the girls prepare for Christmas ranging from Aiko making a metal stocking, the girls preparing a Christmas feast, the girls solving their chimney problem, and the girls preparing for the arrival of Santa Claus.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis:
A. The girls hit the slopes and learn how to ski. When they fail to make a reservation at one of the lodges, they end up staying with some snow people who attempt to add them to their frozen collection.

B. While walking through the woods, the girls find a hot spring that Liru told them about and end up encountering women who turn out to be Tanukis that end up stealing their clothes.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis:
A. The girls play a "speaking English" game hosted by Keimie and a mess-up has them drinking the bad-tasting Natto drink.

B. The girls see Super Doctor K-Ko on a TV show revolving on the theory of horror movie monsters existing amongst the human race. When the co-host of the TV show ends up discovering the girl's secret thanks to footage used by Super Doctor K-Ko, it is then made public. The girls experience fame up to the point where they end up on a discussion show against Super Doctor K-Ko in the discussion if monsters from the Netherworld are dangerous.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis:
A. Aiko finds a VCR that contains her memories as a rerun of the girls' favorite show is airing. When the girls plan to use the VCR to tape it, they end up needing D/A Converter to hook it up to their Digital Television and search the entire country for one.

B. When Uma ends up with a cold, she ends up getting the other girls infected with her magic when they make fun of her. With her magic perfected, she practices it on the town. After curing herself and the other girls of the cold, they soon work on a way to make a Cherry Blossom Tree in front of a hospital bloom early when Uma runs out of magic.

episodes.title: Prima notte - Quello non è un tempo per noi
episodes.synopsis: Le amiche di Nazuna decidono di prendere Ko per divertirsi alle sue spalle per una sera e, forse, aiutarlo a innamorarsi della vampira. Hatsuka, tuttavia, ha più interesse a parlare con Nazuna di ciò che c’è tra lei e quel giovane.

episodes.title: Seconda notte - Volevo proprio incontrarti
episodes.synopsis: Mahiru sta vivendo un momento di contrasto con Ko, e ne parla con la donna misteriosa che incontra la notte, Kiku. L’onesto desiderio di rappacificarsi porterà a una serie di incontri sorprendenti e più pericolosi di quanto chiunque avrebbe mai potuto immaginare.

episodes.title: Terza notte - Tutti sanno che nella casa stregata non ci sono i fantasmi
episodes.synopsis: L’incontro con la detective Anko ha serie conseguenze e mette in stato d’allarme tutta la comunità di vampiri. Nazuna stessa non potrà più fare finta di nulla e, grazie anche alla spinta di Ko, inizierà a indagare sul proprio passato.

episodes.title: Quarta notte - Vuoi diventare capace di correre?
episodes.synopsis: Kabura permette a Ko e Nazuna di esplorare l’ospedale di notte, ma non sembra disposta a parlare troppo facilmente di ciò che sa. C’è un legame tra lei e Nazuna, ma la sua natura è avvolta nel mistero. Comprenderlo sarà essenziale per iniziare a risolvere l’enigma del passato di Nazuna.

episodes.title: Quinta notte – Gli anni che ho trascorso con te
episodes.synopsis: Kabura parla della sua storia e di come questa si intreccia con le origini di Nazuna. Parte del loro passato viene finalmente alla luce, e questo cambierà molto la prospettiva che Nazuna e Ko hanno su ciò che sta accadendo.

episodes.title: Sesta notte – Non era la qualità a preoccuparmi
episodes.synopsis: Nazuna e Ko accompagnano Midori a incontrare una persona inaspettata. L’intenzione è scoprire di più sul passato della vampira per eliminare i suoi punti deboli, e nessuno è più adatto ad aiutarli della sua misteriosa conoscenza.

episodes.title: Settima notte – Tu sei scema, Nanakusa
episodes.synopsis: When Ko finds the diary of a girl called Kyoko, he discovers that he wasn't Nazuna's first human friend. Nor the first person she ever considered turning...

episodes.title: Ottava notte – Sei la prima con cui voglio farlo, senpai
episodes.synopsis: What began as Kyoko and Nazuna's investigation into a supposed affair led to a life-changing event that altered their relationship forever.

episodes.title: Nona notte – Tu cosa hai intenzione di fare, Yamori?
episodes.synopsis: Vampires cannot be harmed by conventional means, so what does Anko hope to accomplish by shooting them out in the open? Ko suspects there’s a method to her madness.

episodes.title: Decima notte – Volevo almeno che lo facessi tu
episodes.synopsis: As the battle between vampire and hunter erupts, Ko finally realizes the full scope of what's at stake. Now he must stop both Anko and Nazuna before it's too late.

episodes.title: Undicesima notte – Pciù
episodes.synopsis: Something's wrong. Or maybe too right. Ko isn't a vampire, so why does it feel like his body's ignoring the rules? He and Nazuna need answers.

episodes.title: Dodicesima notte – Il richiamo della notte
episodes.synopsis: Growing up doesn't guarantee answers to life. As Ko wonders what it means to be ordinary, he and Nazuna venture through the city. Where will the night take them this time?

info.title: Swallowed Star
info.synopsis:
Un giorno, il virus RR di origine sconosciuta appare sulla Terra, scatenando un disastro globale. Gli animali infetti mutano in mostri spaventosi e attaccano su larga scala. Di fronte all'imminente distruzione, gli esseri umani costruiscono muri e fondano città come ultimi bastioni dell'umanità. Le prove che il genere umano affronta in questo periodo vengono chiamate "Periodo Nirvana".

In un ambiente di vita così estremo, la forza fisica umana si evolve gradualmente, fioriscono le arti marziali e le capacità fisiche raggiungono livelli qualitativamente superiori rispetto al passato. I migliori tra loro vengono chiamati "Guerrieri". Il diciottenne Luo Feng sogna di diventarne uno. In procinto di affrontare l'esame di ammissione all'università e una scelta cruciale per il suo futuro, un improvviso attacco di mostri ne altera il destino.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: The RR virus has brought monsters, and mankind has entered the era of Nirvana. In the case of the fall of many countries, only five major countries survived, formed the Earth Alliance and established bases. The main reason for the survival of human beings is that warriors were born among human beings under the influence of RR virus antibodies. Back to 5 years ago, Luo Feng, who was born in a low-rent area, decided to take the college entrance examination in order to realize his dream of becoming a martial artist. That day, Luo Feng met Xu Xin on the street and was about to talk to him. At this time, a flying alien appeared in the sky...

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: After Luo Feng left the school gate, he was besieged by Zhang Haobai, a senior martial arts student, and three others. Luo Feng was in excellent physical condition and fell three people down in a few strokes. The next day was the college entrance examination. Luo Feng left early, and was actually blocked by a group of punks. It turned out that Zhang Haobai had come to hold Luo Feng to prevent him from taking the college entrance examination. Although he was overwhelmed, Luo Feng was still late. Thanks to Mr. Jiang’s help, Luo Feng was allowed to take the exam...

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: The simulation location of the Quasi-Martial Artists assessment is set in the old world, which mainly assesses the strength, speed, survivability and the number of monsters killed. Luo Feng passed the assessment with the first overall quality ranking, and also won the quasi-martialist award-the gene source energy training method, and the actual combat assessment is scheduled for the first of next month...

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰的爸爸迟迟没有接他的电话，他不放心，按照爸爸今天说过的地址找了过去，正看到张昊白家的保镖在欺负爸爸和那些工人。罗峰十分生气，出手打倒了那些欺负他爸爸的人，然而张昊白早就算好了这一步，他报警说张昊白私闯民宅，罗峰被警察带走了。警察厅的人得知罗峰参加了准武者考核的时候十分吃惊，罗峰被关进的那间屋子里也有一天个十分不怀好意的人，他也曾经通过过准武者考核，罗峰不想和他正面交手，一直在躲避着。原来这又是张昊白搞得鬼，甚至找到了曾经的武者眼镜蛇，他制造了史上最严重的实战伤亡记录。

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰正在修炼五星向天的功法，忽然感到了仿佛被毒蛇盯上的毛骨悚然的感觉，罗峰回过神来，查看四周，但是他暂时没有发现异常，但是他总感觉有一股恶意在逼近他。正在吃饭的罗峰被几个人盯上了，他们打翻了罗峰的饭盆，摆明了要挑事，而眼镜蛇此时正坐在食堂的另一头，等待着最后出场解决罗峰。罗峰一个人应付他们也绰绰有余，罗峰将那几人都打趴下之后警报响了起来，眼镜蛇还十分惋惜的说只能速战速决，说着就攻击起了罗峰。罗峰和眼镜蛇的对战十分焦灼，罗峰的强大的精神力让原本会刺中他眼睛的飞到改变了方向，而这也让他因为精神力过度使用而头疼不已，眼镜蛇也没想到他的飞刀居然会失误。

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰在和教官进行训练，教官教授了罗峰入微级身法，只要一点点轻微的移动就可以神不知鬼不觉的躲开敌人的攻击，其原理是通过观察对方的动作轨迹做出预判，以最小幅度的动作来躲避攻击的身法，这时建立在大量战斗经验基础上的技术，就连身法分段位就连武者也是分段位的，战士级、战将级、以及极为稀少的战神级，每一级之间都存在着实力的绝对压制。五大国之一的华夏只有两三名超越战神的武者，就在这时诸葛教官到了，江年带着罗峰去见了诸葛教官。

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: 诸葛发现考场里突然出现了一只Ｄ级的金兀鹫，但他判断金兀鹫刚刚孵化不久，实力完全符合考场的设定登记，准武者们只要战术得当，即使不能战胜金兀鹫，也应当可以逃脱它的追捕。而罗峰恰好是距离金兀鹫最近的准武者，罗峰果然对着金兀鹫发动了攻击，诸葛教官等人在监控上看着罗峰的全部作战过程，罗峰完美的战术成功击杀了那只金兀鹫。罗峰等人顺利完成了考核，成为了真正的武者。

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰完成武者考核顺利加入了火锤小队，然而在罗峰进入火锤小队的第一天就有突发任务需要罗峰出马。他们到达了集合地，了解到ＨＲ联盟名下的生物研究所组成了一支志愿小队前往０２０１县城采集怪兽基因样本，报警的人希望火锤小队能够将困在里面的人尽快解救出来。罗峰发现徐欣的名字也在搜救人员的名单里，罗峰决定一定要尽快救出被困住的人。罗峰遇见犀牛怪，使出了九重雷刀，就在这时火锤小队赶来帮他解决了。\n\n各个小队分开集合，罗峰发下来他送给徐欣的匕首落在了地上，然而没想到的是，在这片废墟中还有另一伙人藏在这里，他们决定暗中除掉罗峰，却被火锤小队的队员们发现了他们的踪迹。最终在千钧一发之际，罗峰赶到了徐欣的身边，在怪兽袭击她的前一秒打败了怪兽。本次营救任务顺利完成。

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰救出徐欣之后连忙向着安全地方撤退，此时一个人一直在高楼上看着她们，不久，罗峰小队就被一直初级战兽双尾虎猫拦住了去路，火锤小队的队长高峰负责断后，让罗峰等人先带着徐欣撤离，与此同时潘亚等人组成的小队正在不远处的高楼上监视着他们的一举一动，她们决定出手击杀高风，趁火锤小队手足无措的时候将他们各个击破，躲进了废墟里的罗峰等人也被三头怪兽包围了，罗峰利用他精神年时的能力成功击杀了三头怪兽，与此同时高风也解决了双尾虎猫，潘亚等人决定利用高风去引出他们想要猎杀的怪兽，最后在坐收渔翁之利。\n\n而火锤小队此时已经从徐欣的描述中了解到了潘亚等人想要做的事情，他们猜测对方想要捕杀的怪兽还没露面，而他们很可能被对方当成了新的诱饵。潘亚开启超声波将银月凶狼引到了火锤小队的附近，张科被火箭弹打断了一条胳膊，众人逃跑的道路也被潘亚堵住了，大家一时之间伤亡惨重。而高风也发现这一切是虎牙小队做的，他们连忙撤退了，然而这些动静将周围的战兽全都引来了，罗峰等人陷入了前所未有的危急时刻。

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: 被怪兽包围的火锤小队疲于逃命，罗峰为了掩护大家安全离开只好将他是精神念师的事情暴露了出来，而银月凶狼也盯上了罗峰等人，与此同时潘亚等人打算去追击受了上的银月凶狼，这也是他门此行的真正目的。罗峰十分愧疚，他觉得他们这次被虎牙小队针对，很可能是因为罗峰之前得罪了张泽虎，张科的手笔被打断了一条，大家都清楚他的武者生涯算是到此为止了。

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: 领主级怪兽巨岩黑熊正在接近江南基地市，幸好战神陆纲及时出现，依靠九重雷刀击败了巨岩黑熊...

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: 为了尽快领悟九重雷刀的第二重，罗峰独自前往了0201县城进行历练。却没想到鼠潮意外爆发，为了保护基地市。战神陆纲出现，以身引雷击退了鼠潮，而他自己也化作一缕青烟陨落了。这一幕无疑对罗峰造成了极大的打击，如果自己当时的实力再高一些就好了...

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: 在参加了陆纲的追悼会之后，火锤小队打算去003号城市清理怪兽。这里，怪兽肆虐，罗峰他们还救下了一支印度小队。谁知，雷霆小队和虎牙小队 结伙出现，原来他们是看上了罗峰击杀的猎物...

episodes.title: Episodio 14
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰留下来给火锤小队做掩护，顺便追踪雷霆小队的行踪。为了给张科报仇，罗峰打算解决与雷霆小队同行的虎牙小队。在多天的等待之后，罗峰终于迎来了机会...

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: 两位战神恰巧出现，为雷霆小队解了围，原来他们来这里是为了毁掉即将 孵化的铁甲龙蛋。在嘱咐一番雷霆小队后，两位战神便离开了。罗峰听到这个消息，决定去观看战神和高级领主怪兽的战斗以提升自己的战斗经验...

episodes.title: Episodio 16
episodes.synopsis: 战神与铁甲龙激战不断，为了帮助两位战神，罗峰打算前去摧毁龙蛋。但龙蛋的价值毕竟很高，与其摧毁它还不如将其交给研究机构让龙蛋发挥更大的作用...

episodes.title: Episodio 17
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰摆脱了铁甲龙的追击，却又遇上了雷霆小队和虎牙小队。面对罗峰拿到的铁甲龙蛋，雷霆和虎牙小队都非常眼热。他们抢先对罗峰出手，却反被罗峰一个人击杀..

episodes.title: Episodio 18
episodes.synopsis: 得知儿子意外死亡的消息，李耀夫妇立马发布了1000亿函夏币的悬赏，还 交代了凶手是精神念师的可能性。如果高风队长知道了，会举报罗峰吗。然而，队长的一番话让他打消了怀疑的念头。为了避免被人怀疑，罗峰在第一时间回到了基地市，却得知阿华出事了...

episodes.title: Episodio 19
episodes.synopsis: 罗华自杀未遂，而罗峰当晚就给罗华带回了甄楠给他的信，其实甄楠和罗华分手并不是出自本意。而哥哥罗峰也保证会给阿华买回生命之水，让他安心学习。而李耀那边经过调查有了一份506人的怀疑名单，他宁可错杀一千也不会放过一个...

episodes.title: Episodio 20
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰有了一个可以参加特等培训的机会，而这也意味着，他即将离开火锤小队了...

episodes.title: Episodio 21
episodes.synopsis: 徐欣全力支持罗峰去参加五年的特等培训，罗峰也只好和她相拥而别...

episodes.title: Episodio 22
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰来到了精英训练营的九重楼试练塔参加考核，他会顺利通过考核吗...

episodes.title: Episodio 23
episodes.synopsis: 罗峰在江南阁遇到了自己的史江师兄和赵若师姐，而他们两个也耐心给罗峰讲起了精英训练营的情况...

episodes.title: Episodio 24
episodes.synopsis: 在新生交流会上，罗峰接下了和老学员威廉的赌战...

episodes.title: Episodio 25
episodes.synopsis: 在赢下了与威廉的赌战之后，罗峰遇到了自己接下来五年的人生导师，江芳...

episodes.title: Non esiste che sia amica di Kaho?!
episodes.synopsis: Renako can't bring herself to answer Ajisai's confession and ends up putting it on hold. Feeling guilty toward Mai too, she skips school. Unsure how to respond to both girls' feelings, she stays home and broods. While looking through an old album, she finds a photo of a little girl who looks just like someone in her current group...!?

episodes.title: Non esiste che riesca a fare cosplay!
episodes.synopsis: Renako reluctantly accepts Kaho's invite to a cosplay photoshoot. Renako is so nervous that the first session ends up a disaster, so Kaho launches a "Renako's Magical Modification," making her listen to a mysterious hypnosis track. Renako first thought it was silly, but it leaves her oddly hyped, and she heads into the next shoot full of confidence... with unexpected results.

episodes.title: Non esiste che abbiamo un appuntamento al parco divertimenti!
episodes.synopsis: After the photoshoot, Renako and Kaho have a girls' night at a love hotel. Swept up in Kaho's energy, Renako even ends up bathing with her! Then an unexpected invite to a major event arrives, throwing everything into chaos. Later, Renako, Mai, and Ajisai go to an amusement park - only to face an unforeseen incident...

episodes.title: Non esiste che salga su quel palco!
episodes.synopsis: The requirements for participating in the Cosplay Summit was to compete as a pair. Renako builds up the courage to accept Kaho's invitation and go. After feverishly preparing their cosplays, the summit finally comes around. But then a crisis happens, as Kaho drops her contact lens - the key to her "extrovert cosplay." And in the midst of it all, Mai and Ajisai are also starting to move...

episodes.title: Non esiste che ci mettiamo insieme... oppure sì?
episodes.synopsis: Kaho and Renako are relieved to have finally finished their Cosplay Summit performance, when they're suddenly joined not only by Satuki, but by Ajisai as well! Then Mai appears on the main stage as a special guest. As the four watch her shine, Ajisai rushes to join Mai under the bright lights, and Ajisai and Kaho urge Renako to come along. At last, Renako makes her decision...?!

info.title: Marriage of God & Soul Godannar!!
info.synopsis: Cinque anni fa, mentre combatteva contro una forza aliena conosciuta come “Mimesis”, il pilota Dannar Goh Saruwatari incontrò per la prima volta Anna Aoi. Oggi, nel giorno del loro matrimonio, la cerimonia viene interrotta quando i Mimesis attaccano di nuovo. Mentre Goh lotta contro la minaccia aliena, Anna si imbatte in un robot top secret chiamato “Neo-Okusaer” e lo usa come ultima risorsa per salvare il suo fidanzato. In quel momento, Dannar e Neo-Okusaer si fondono per diventare il potente robot “Godannar”.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Five years ago, while battling an alien force known as the "Mimesis," Dannar pilot Goh Saruwatari first met Anna Aoi. Today, on the day of their wedding, the ceremony is interrupted when the Mimesis strike again. As Goh struggles in his battle against the alien threat, Anna stumbles upon a top secret robot known as the "Neo-Okusaer" and uses it as a last-resort to save her fiance. At that moment, Dannar and Neo-Okusaer merge to become the mighty robot "Godannar.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: As Anna begins her rigerous training as a robot pilot, she and Goh also try to adjust to their first days of living together. After a silly argument which has Anna go into town to blow off some steam, the mimetec they fought last week appears, attacking Anna directly.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: When a Mimetec appears in the South China Sea, robot teams from several nations gather to battle it. Meanwhile, Anna and Goh vow to battle together through thick and thin.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Shizuru begins to question if she belongs on Dannar base any longer, especially after Goh and Anna are hurt in battle. But after encouragement from Anna, Shizuru's confidence is rejuvinated and she, Anna, and Goh defeat the latest Mimetec threat.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: When Astro Base is attacked by a Mimetec, Lou is forced to eject to Earth while her father stays to protect the base. When Lou and Goh return to the base to keep it from crashing in Earth, they end up fighting the Mimetec to avenge Lou's father.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis:
未だに、ミラを失った5年前の戦いの悪夢にうなされるゴオに、ある日霧子から衝撃的な事実を打ち明けられる。

5年前の戦いで死亡したと思われていた、戦友マックスとかつての恋人ミラが生きていたというのだ。

しかし、ミラは記憶も知識も全く失ってしまっていた。

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: The newly revived Max steals Myra away, leading to a confrontation with Goh, whom he blames for losing her in the first place.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: In the wake of Max' attack, Knight Valentine stirs up trouble, one woman at a time.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: After the fighters crash on an island, Dannar Base begins to send out rescue ships. Go, Anna, Knight, and Ellis inspect the damage to their robots. Okusaer and Dannar can move, but the jetboys are heavily damaged, so the four of them are stuck there.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis:
戦闘禁止地区において何者かによる戦闘の痕跡が見つかり、Menage-Zeroが発令された。

そこ残された多数の擬態獣の死骸が、父親を襲った擬態獣と同じであることを知ったルウは戦いに参加したいと申し出る。

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Lu is reprimanded for her actions while Goh encounters the rogue mech pilot.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: With Godannar and Neo-Okusaer out of commission, the only one to challenge a new Mimetic threat is Shizuru.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: While the base reels at the loss of one of their own, Anna continues to sort things out.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: The Ashikaga forces keep a vigilant watch across the country, searching for remnants of the Hojo clan scattered throughout Japan. Sadamune, the governor of Shinano, has grown suspicious of “Chojumaru,” a young warrior who has repeatedly distinguished himself in battle—first during the dog-shooting competition, and later on the battlefield.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Provincial official Kiyohara returns to Shinano after fleeing back to Kyo following the previous battle. Having grown even more ruthless, Kiyohara launches a large-scale invasion against pro-Hojo factions in northern Shinano. To oppose the combined forces of Kiyohara and Sadamune, the three great generals of the Suwa faith—Nezu, Mochizuki, and Unno, retainers directly serving Yorishige.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Tokiyuki and his companions race across the battlefield, sparing even the slightest moments of rest in order to relay information to their allies. However, when they arrive at the northern front where Mochizuki and Tokoiwa are fighting, what they witness is a fortress engulfed in flames, falliing into ruin... Ayako collapses in grief as she thinks of her father, Shigenobu Mochizuki.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: The central battlefield descends into total chaos. Just as victory seems within reach for the Hoshina–Shinomiya forces, a new obstacle suddenly appears before them: Kiyohara’s newly devised battle mikoshi. Originally intended as a palanquin for issuing commands from the rear, it is now reinforced with heavy armor.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The battle ends in defeat for the Suwa Sect. Although they manage to keep casualties to a minimum, the losses they suffer are significant. As they look toward the next great conflict, everyone in the Suwa Sect comes to share an even stronger resolve. The battle becomes another valuable lesson for Tokiyuki as well—one that helps him grow even further.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Tokiyuki’s uncle, Yasuie Hojo, is still alive! Once a key figure at the heart of the Kamakura Shogunate, Yasuie survives the fall of Kamakura. Afterward, he travels throughout the Tohoku region, continuing to fight alongside the remaining Hojo loyalists. But after suffering defeat after defeat, he eventually finds his way to Suwa.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: At the suggestion of Yorishige and Yasuie, Tokiyuki sets out for the capital, Kyo, together with the Elusive Warriors. Major Counselor Kinmune Saionji, an ally of Yasuie, awaits their arrival in Kyo. While Yasuie and Kinmune conduct a secret discussion, Tokiyuki and his companions venture out into the city.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Having grown closer over a game of dice, Mima invites Tokiyuki and his companions on a tour of Kyo. Even though they know she is the daughter of their enemy, the Elusive Warriors accept her kindness and spend a brief, youthful moment enjoying themselves as ordinary boys and girls. However, upon returning to the Saionji's residence, Tokiyuki and the others are informed of a plan for an uprising.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Through his dialogue with the warrior Masashige Kusunoki, known as a “god of war,” Tokiyuki is moved by Kusunoki's unwavering convictions and develops an even deeper sense of confidence in the possibilities of “fleeing.” Just as he is smiling over this fortunate encounter, everything suddenly changes when he hears news of his sworn enemy Takauji’s movements.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Although the attempt to assassinate Takauji ends in failure, Tokiyuki has grown significantly as a warrior through his experiences in Kyo. Upon his return to Suwa, Yorishige tells him that the time has finally come. The attempted assassinations of both the Emperor and Takauji plunged Kyo into chaos, where warriors from the Kanto area were summoned and the city's defenses were reinforced.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: With preparations for war complete, the Suwa forces are finally about to ignite the great conflict. Tokiyuki is appointed commander-in-chief, taking command of the “Kamakura Party,” a unit formed from surviving retainers of the Hojo clan—while keeping his true identity hidden. Can he prove himself worthy as a leader to those who feel uneasy about serving under a child?

Durante la visita, i ricordi del passato si intrecciano con le nuove sfide del presente, mentre ritrova volti familiari e scopre quanto siano cambiati gli eroi che un tempo l'hanno salvata. Adattamento dell'omonimo one-shot pubblicato nel fanbook del 2025 Boku no Hero Academia: Ultra Age.
